title: The Sharp Ghost
author: Hazel Thornbury
blurb: Casper Marchetti, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
